summary: File Attachment Feature Testing - Complete. All backend and frontend tests passed. Upload endpoint accepts multipart file upload, returns file_id/filename/size, rejects files >10MB, requires auth. UI shows 'Attach Files' button with paperclip icon, attachment chips display after upload with filename/size/remove button, Send button shows file count. Next Step card still works correctly after camp interaction.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor hydration warning from dynamic coach options, not blocking functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: File attachment feature fully tested. Key behaviors: (1) POST /api/gmail/upload-attachment accepts multipart/form-data, returns {file_id, filename, size, content_type}, stores in db.temp_attachments, (2) 10MB limit enforced, (3) POST /api/gmail/send accepts optional attachment_ids array, (4) UI shows 'Attach Files' button with paperclip icon, (5) After upload, attachment chips show filename/size with X remove button, (6) Send button text updates to show file count (e.g., 'Send Email (2 files)'), (7) Gmail not connected for test accounts so actual send returns 403 - expected behavior. UCLA program now has 9 events including camp interactions.
